# AI-DLC V2 Active

78-stage lifecycle methodology. Full protocols and conventions in AGENTS.md.

## How to Start
- Run `/aidlc` to begin or resume
- Or describe your development intent

## Organization
- **AGENTS.md** — Protocols, conventions, oversized skills (always loaded)
- **.windsurf/rules/** — Individual skills and pack skills (loaded by context)
- **.windsurf/workflows/aidlc.md** — `/aidlc` trigger

## Constraints
- Never skip stages or produce placeholders
- Evidence before claims — verify, don't assume
- One unit per session for code generation
- Quality gates with self-healing remediation loops
- Independent reviewer validates each stage
